glosses: cabin (the passenger area of an airplane)
cabin (a private room on a ship)
cockpit (the space for those in control of a vessel)

examples.text: Que tengas buena suerte para encontrar una cabina telefónica aquí.
examples.en: Good luck finding a phone booth here.

examples.text: Ellos eligen a sus representantes en una cabina de votación.
examples.en: They elect their representatives in a voting booth.

examples.text: Tom nos dijo que comeríamos en cuanto llegáramos a la cabina.
examples.en: Tom told us that we would eat as soon as we got to the cabin.
